snippet.title: Nerds Revenge - Trailer
snippet.description:
The smarter you are… the harder you hit. 🧠💥

Welcome to Nerds Revenge - a chaotic party brawler where your IQ decides your fate.

Answer correctly to upgrade your weapon.
Fail… and suffer the consequences.

Fight your friends with ridiculous items, dominate the map, and prove once and for all: brains - brawn.

🎮 WHAT TO EXPECT:
• Fast-paced multiplayer chaos
• Quiz-powered combat system
• Random, absurd weapons
• Map control & tactical advantages
• Perfect for parties and destroying friendships

This is not just a fighting game.
This is a battle of intelligence.
